Welcome to this 3,500 square foot, five-bedroom home nestled in the heart of Rittenhouse Square, surrounded by the luxury of Walnut Street boutiques and high-rise condo towers like The Laurel. A dramatic spiral staircase creates an impressive first impression as you enter the foyer. The formal living room features a large picture window that fills the space with natural light and a cozy fireplace, while the adjoining dining room offers the perfect setting for holiday gatherings and entertaining. The chef's kitchen is designed for both everyday living and special occasions, featuring abundant cabinetry, generous counter space, and a pantry for added storage. Just off the kitchen, the inviting family room offers a second fireplace and picturesque views of the lush backyard. A versatile fifth bedroom on the main level can also serve as a private home office, guest room, or study. Completing the first floor are a convenient powder room and laundry room. Upstairs, the spacious landing leads to the primary suite, featuring a dedicated makeup area and an en-suite bathroom. Three additional generously sized bedrooms and a full hall bathroom with a tub provide plenty of space for family and guests. The expansive unfinished basement offers endless possibilities to create additional living space, whether you envision a recreation room, home gym, office, or media room. Step outside to the covered patio and enjoy the peaceful backyard retreat. With mature landscaping and ample space for outdoor games, gardening, entertaining, or simply relaxing, this backyard is ready to become your personal oasis. This wonderful home offers hardwood floors, 3 zoned heating, 2 zoned air conditioning, and a 2-car garage with heat. Enjoy the space, comfort, and flexibility both inside and out—an exceptional opportunity in a sought-after location. Walk to Rittenhouse Square, enjoy the James Beard restaurant density, and access to the Market-Frankford and trolley lines nearby.

A meticulously renovated duplex in the heart of Rittenhouse Square, just steps from the park's lush greenery and surrounded by Walnut Street's luxury retail and boutiques. 413 S 51st Street is a legal duplex that has been thoughtfully redesigned, featuring all new mechanicals, brand new electrical systems, and high-end finishes that perfectly blend historic character with contemporary comfort. The larger owner unit spans three impressive levels, offering 5 bedrooms and 3.5 baths of refined living space. First floor: step through the inviting entry into a warm and sophisticated library/home office/guest bedroom, complete with a stylish half bath and framed by the home’s beautiful original staircase—a striking nod to its historic roots. Second floor: an elegant living room overlooks Rittenhouse Square, featuring a custom-built TV wall with shelving and a modern fireplace, creating a perfect gathering space. The breathtaking kitchen is a true showpiece—equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, a large waterfall island with deep sink, and an adjoining drink bar with wine fridge. A guest suite or study with an en suite bath, plus a laundry area and pantry space, complete this level with both beauty and practicality. Third floor: the primary suite offers peaceful park views and a spa-inspired primary bathroom with double sinks, a soaking tub, and a separate glass shower. Two additional bedrooms and a full hall bathroom provide generous space for family or guests. Every detail of this house has been carefully designed for comfort, functionality, and style. The rear portion of the first floor hosts a charming large 1 bed 1 bath apartment, fully renovated with all new appliances, modern finishes, and its own laundry and home office area. With a separate electric meter, this unit offers privacy and independence—ideal for tenants or extended family. The potential rental income can significantly offset your mortgage, adding exceptional value to this remarkable property. From the high-end craftsmanship inside to the refreshed exterior curb appeal, this home delivers modern luxury in one of Philadelphia's most sought-after neighborhoods—just moments from Rittenhouse Square, top-rated restaurants, and the city's best cafes.
